rules.not_applicable: Requires explicit genuine scope reason; unavailable runtime is not N/A
rules.release_gate: All critical evaluations observed; publication and production cutover separately owner-gated

evaluations.pass: Installed candidate preserves default stdio first-win behavior, schema v12, and the exact 17-tool contract.
evaluations.fail: Existing valid stdio clients require migration or contract behavior changes.
evaluations.inconclusive: Required installed package or client runtime cannot be exercised.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Clean installed wheel and sdist; discover/list/store, close client process, fresh process recall decision and rationale.
evaluations.bad_probe: Alter a fixture tool name/schema or break startup and confirm acceptance rejects it.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Unavailable server executable yields an explicit unavailable/non-pass result.

evaluations.pass: SDK Streamable HTTP exposes identical 17-tool schemas/digest and durable store/recall behavior.
evaluations.fail: Extra/missing tools, altered schemas, duplicate business logic, or custom HTTP RPC.
evaluations.inconclusive: Server cannot be reached for an unrelated environmental reason.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Standard MCP HTTP client initialization, list, store, recall against installed candidate.
evaluations.bad_probe: Altered tool-contract fixture is rejected by parity checker.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Closed port is reported unreachable, without local fallback.

evaluations.pass: 2026-07-28 and advertised supported older protocol/client paths list and call tools on SDK floor and latest supported SDK.
evaluations.fail: Advertised path breaks or SDK floor silently increases.
evaluations.inconclusive: Required SDK/client version cannot be obtained or run.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Floor/latest 2.x server matrix with modern and supported legacy MCP clients over HTTP; stdio controls.
evaluations.bad_probe: Invalid protocol/session request is rejected or negotiated per specification, never silently treated as valid.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Missing legacy client is INCONCLUSIVE, not inferred from raw-wire success.

evaluations.pass: Unique memory and authority identity survive container deletion/replacement using only documented persistent local state.
evaluations.fail: State is lost, ephemeral, or identity unexpectedly changes.
evaluations.inconclusive: Container runtime or volume cannot be exercised.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Build image, store marker, remove application container, recreate from clean image with same volume, recall marker.
evaluations.bad_probe: Fresh different volume cannot recall marker and cannot masquerade as prior authority.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Unavailable Docker daemon is explicit non-pass.

evaluations.pass: Independent clients reach one authority; outage yields transport failure and no fallback writer.
evaluations.fail: Any client silently creates or writes an independent local authority.
evaluations.inconclusive: Independent clients or controlled candidate outage cannot be exercised.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Two fresh clients share marker/authority; stop only isolated test authority and observe failure.
evaluations.bad_probe: Unavailable endpoint must not allow successful store or create a local DB.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Missing second client evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.

evaluations.pass: Actual mount classifier fixtures reject NFS/CIFS/SMB authority storage in hardened deployment; local storage accepted.
evaluations.fail: Known unsafe remote filesystem starts hardened authority.
evaluations.inconclusive: Filesystem type cannot be established; report unknown rather than safe.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Local filesystem fixture and live local-volume classification.
evaluations.bad_probe: NFS/CIFS mounted at innocent path, nested mount and symlink fixtures fail before DB mutation.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Unavailable mount metadata remains unknown and cannot satisfy hardened safety.

evaluations.pass: Safe default bind; configured Host/Origin boundary rejects invalid requests; no secret logging; intentional authenticated/private exposure boundary.
evaluations.fail: Default or hardened deployment accidentally exposes unauthenticated public service or leaks credentials.
evaluations.inconclusive: Documented authentication/overlay boundary cannot be tested.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Loopback default and explicit allowed host/origin; documented secured deployment path.
evaluations.bad_probe: Invalid Origin/Host, broad unconfigured bind, unauthorized request, and secret-log canary.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Missing external security boundary evidence is stated, not assumed from documentation.

evaluations.pass: Healthy candidate ready; inaccessible/mismatched DB/schema/authority not ready; health exposes no memory.
evaluations.fail: Readiness remains green while authority is unusable.
evaluations.inconclusive: Safe failure injection or HTTP endpoint unavailable.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Container HEALTHCHECK and HTTP liveness/readiness with expected schema/contract.
evaluations.bad_probe: Isolated DB inaccessible/missing/schema mismatch transitions readiness to failure without recreating authority.

evaluations.pass: Consistent actual NAS authority copy retains explained epoch handling, durable rows/content, namespaces, indexes, representative recall/write, run/signal state; rollback rehearsed.
evaluations.fail: Unexplained durable-state/retrieval divergence or unrecoverable rollback.
evaluations.inconclusive: Required source artifact or realistic snapshot cannot be inspected.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Immutable backup, isolated clone, before/after manifests and spot checks, write only clone, restore into separate rollback copy.
evaluations.bad_probe: Deliberate fixture row/content divergence or corrupt snapshot rejected despite equal row counts.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Absent real snapshot cannot be replaced by synthetic-only PASS.

evaluations.pass: Machine A stores decision/rationale, disconnects; fresh client on independent machine B retrieves it through official candidate authority.
evaluations.fail: Decision/rationale cannot be recovered or clients reach different stores.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Observed two-machine store/disconnect/fresh-client natural project question and recall.
evaluations.bad_probe: Different authority or incorrect namespace cannot satisfy marker/rationale assertion.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Two processes on one host alone cannot substitute for two-machine evidence.

evaluations.pass: Small and large valid export complete exactly or return deliberate documented bounded response on supported modern/legacy HTTP paths.
evaluations.fail: Hang, silent truncation, corrupted payload, or opaque transport failure on supported valid workload.
evaluations.inconclusive: A required protocol/SDK path cannot be exercised.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Small control and realistic/deliberately large export up to 500 entries, exact entry/content verification with timeout.
evaluations.bad_probe: Truncated/corrupted response fixture and timeout must fail acceptance.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Missing legacy path is not inferred to pass from modern path.

evaluations.pass: Frozen clean candidate SHA, package version, image version/revision labels, tested artifacts, and approved release source tag agree.
evaluations.fail: Artifacts built from mutable main or versions/revisions do not match.
evaluations.inconclusive: Tag/publication not authorized or tested immutable artifact evidence missing; report candidate-only checks separately.
evaluations.adequate_good_probe: Build from frozen SHA, install wheel/sdist, inspect labels/digests and tag-target check without publishing.
evaluations.bad_probe: Mismatched version/revision/tag rejected before release publication.
evaluations.unavailable_evidence_probe: Missing image/tag cannot be claimed verified; future owner step remains explicit.
